Subject: BlueOcean - Order Form amendment: SKU reassignment & fee alignment

Hi Marta —

Per our call this morning, BlueOcean wants to shift 30% of the committed Dedicated capacity from inference-gpu-sku-A to a mixed GPU pool (inference-gpu-sku-B + burst). You also requested a six-week phased implementation (to avoid disruption to the onboarding plan) and a fee reconciliation that reflects the SKU mix rather than the original flat rate.

Attached is a first-pass Order Form supplement that captures: addendum header, SKU reassignment table, phased implementation milestones, and a preliminary fee apportionment (lines 7–12). This is intentionally high level so we can align on intent before Legal does line-by-line redlines.

Two asks from my side:
- Can you confirm the effective date you want on the amendment (start of next billing period vs. immediate pro-rata)?
- Please confirm the phased window you expect for cutover (you mentioned ~6 weeks on the call).

If the business approves, I’ll loop in Laura (Legal) for redlines and Rishi for pricing sign-off.

Thanks —
Jonas

Jonas —

Thanks for the doc and for capturing the call. A few clarifications from our procurement / ops side:
1) Effective date: we prefer the amendment go live at the start of our next billing cycle (2026-10-01) with pro-rata credit applied for any early use.
2) Phased window: confirmed 6 weeks, with week 1–2 smoke tests, week 3–4 progressive routing split, week 5 rollback window, week 6 full cutover.
3) Pricing: procurement wants line-level SKU pricing (so we can map to internal chargeback). Can you provide the per-SKU monthly rate and the pro-rata formula?

I’ve attached our redlines to the supplement (BOH_redlines_20260824.pdf) — mostly definitions and a short SOW addition to clarify support SLAs during the cutover. Legal will need to see your tracked changes.

Jonas / Rishi —

I reviewed the customer redlines and drafted tracked changes in the supplement. Summary of material points and proposed positions:

1) Effective date / credits — customer requests start 2026-10-01 with pro-rata credits for early usage. Position: acceptable, provided we cap the pro-rata at one billing cycle and require written activation confirmation from BlueOcean ops.

2) SLA & acceptance criteria during cutover — redline adds a support escalation matrix and an acceptance checklist. Position: we can accept a limited acceptance checklist (connectivity, API throughput, KV cache consistency) but need to exclude third-party downstream dependencies from acceptance gates.

3) Liability / credits — customer wants credits to be the exclusive remedy for migration failure. Position: retain mutual remedies clause; we can offer a migration-specific credit schedule (tiered by severity) but not full liability replacement.

4) Pricing transparency — customer asks for per-SKU rates and pro-rata formula. Request commercial to provide a simple table; I suggest we lock rates for the 12-month term and add a right to renegotiate if wholesale pricing materially changes.

I attached two files to the shared Drive (tracked supplement and a short memo). If commercial confirms the pricing table, I can produce a clean redline to send back.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
